_comment: Companies whose public ATS job boards are read by `python main.py --source ats`. ats: greenhouse | lever | ashby; slug: the board name in the API URL; EU-hosted Greenhouse boards (e.g. Valtech, job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io) are served by the same API host; boards-api.eu.greenhouse.io does not resolve (checked 2026-11-17). name is the display/company name stored in job_searches.company (blacklist and aggregator matching use it). Set active to false to stop reading a board without losing its history. Synced into the companies table on every SQLiteStorage init.
